effects.does: It opens Clara to generate or assist with RFP questions.

effects.does: It validates the event and starts the publish flow.

cases.title: Title remains locked during RFQ-to-auction conversion
steps: Click "Enter the title of the project".
Try to edit the Product, Product Variant, and Quantity Requested values.
cases.expected: The title field cannot be edited. Existing Product, Product Variant, and Quantity Requested values remain locked.
cases.setup: Open an RFQ-to-auction conversion containing at least one existing line item.

cases.title: Blacklisted and TNA vendors cannot be selected
steps: Try to select each restricted vendor.
cases.expected: The blacklisted vendor is disabled and shows "Blocked". The TNA vendor is disabled and shows "TNA". Neither vendor can be selected.
cases.setup: Use a fresh event where the search results include one blacklisted vendor and one TNA vendor.
gaps: Search for the blacklisted vendor and identify its result
Assert the blacklisted vendor result is disabled and shows "Blocked"
Try to select the blacklisted vendor and assert that selection is refused
Search for the TNA vendor and identify its result
Assert the TNA vendor result is disabled and shows "TNA"
Try to select the TNA vendor and assert that selection is refused

cases.title: Publish refuses an event with no participants
cases.expected: Publishing stops and the app shows "Please add participants to proceed!".
cases.setup: Open a conversion that has the displayed participant selected.

cases.title: Ask Clara generates a summary for an event with line items
steps: Wait for the AI response to load.
cases.expected: The AI request is submitted and the resulting Clara summary or response panel appears for the event.
cases.setup: Open a conversion containing at least one completed line item with Product and Quantity Requested values.
gaps: Whether the AI request was submitted to the backend because the request endpoint is not specified.
Whether the response contains a correct Clara summary for the event's line items.
A response panel that is not exposed as a named or dialog accessibility element.

cases.title: Buy Template is unavailable on the conversion screen
cases.expected: "Buy Template" is visibly disabled and no template-purchase action or new screen opens.

cases.title: Publish opens the conversion confirmation
cases.expected: A confirmation dialog opens with title "Send to Auction Team" and the action text "Send to Auction Team" or "Publish". The dialog also offers "Edit Schedule" as the cancellation action.
cases.setup: Open a valid conversion with a title, at least one line item, and at least one participant.
